name: Domino's Pizza - Union Place
address: 505 Union Pl, Colombo 00200, Sri Lanka
types: establishment, food, meal_delivery, meal_takeaway, point_of_interest, restaurant
review_texts:
I visited this Domino’s outlet recently, and my experience was just okay. The pizza was fine, but it didn’t taste as good as I expected. The service was a little slow, and the place didn’t feel very welcoming. Prices are reasonable, but they really need to improve the taste and service. I hope they do better next time. | Had the Heart Shaped Pizza Combo at Domino’s Pizza - Union Place and it was such a cute and delicious experience! ❤️🍕 The pizza was fresh, cheesy, and perfectly baked, and the combo was totally worth it.

A special thank you to Bevan at cashier for the excellent service. His attitude was extremely good — very friendly, professional, and attentive throughout. He really made the whole experience even better.

Good food and outstanding customer service. Highly recommend this branch! 👏✨ | I placed an order for the Iftar Combo through the Domino’s app on 27th February at 5:50 PM for pickup from the Union Place outlet. The app indicated that the order was ready at 6:07 PM. I arrived at 6:12 PM; however, the order was not prepared and the staff appeared to be occupied with arranging the outlet.
When I inquired with the cashier, I was informed it would be ready within 5 minutes, but the delay continued. In total, I waited nearly 40 minutes to receive my order, which unfortunately caused me to miss Iftar despite ordering in advance.
What was particularly disappointing was the lack of acknowledgment or apology for the delay and inconvenience. During peak Iftar hours, timely service and clear communication are essential and this was not delivered.
The food quality did not meet expectations. The pizza was one of the least enjoyable I have had it lacked freshness and flavour and overall it was not tasty at all. Considering the total bill of Rs. 3,999, the experience did not reflect value for money.
I sincerely hope the management reviews both operational efficiency and food quality standards, especially during high-demand periods, to prevent similar experiences in the future. | There’s something comforting about a Domino's pizza, and the Union Place location in Colombo is my reliable spot for satisfying that specific craving. It's not a fancy Italian restaurant experience; it's a bustling, practical place that delivers exactly what you expect: fast, hot, and satisfying comfort food.
What I Love About It:
The best part is the consistency. The pizza always tastes exactly like it should. Their local favorites, like the Hot Chilli Chicken and the Double Chicken, have that familiar flavor profile that just hits right every time. The staff here generally keep things moving efficiently and usually have a friendly attitude, even during the lunch rush.
It's also great for value. I usually take advantage of their ongoing deals, which makes feeding a group of friends affordable. The garlic bread is a must-have side, and wrapping up the meal with a warm Choco Lava Cake is a perfect ending.
Things to Keep in Mind:
The atmosphere is definitely "fast-food busy." If you go during a peak hour (like a Friday night dinner rush), you might have to wait a little longer, and the dining area can get quite crowded. It's a quick-stop kind of place, not somewhere you linger for a quiet, relaxed dinner.
Overall Verdict:
For a satisfying, tasty pizza experience that delivers exactly what the international chain promises, the Union Place location is a solid choice. It's a great spot for a quick, affordable meal when you're in the area and need that reliable Domino's flavor. | Food and service are generally good, though it can get a bit hectic during busy hours and finding a table isn’t always easy. One downside is the lack of parking right in front, which can be inconvenient.

Overall experience has been positive, although on my last visit the volcano pizza arrived late and dried out. Still, apart from that, it’s a decent spot. The space is a bit smaller compared to some other Domino’s branches but manageable.

name: FLOW
address: 200 Union Pl, Colombo 00200, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
Fantastic selection for the price (I don't remember the exact price but there was a 25% off HSBC Card offer that made the price person about LKR5500!).

All the meats (especially the pork and lamb) were well seasoned and done to perfection. I've had so many styles of pork ribs (i lived in Texas for 4 years so I know good ribs) I can say by far, yesterday's was the best I have ever had (I ate 7 🤣). It was spicy and so well marinated - catered to our palette. The chicken Tikka masala curry was so yummy, my parents were discussing how it tastes like the ones we had in India itself! I loved the cheese selection as well. The mushroom soup was to die for - the strong mushroom taste was right up my alley. Even the action stations did a good job. I loved the selection of pickles and the tasty salad dressings as well. Oh and the desserts! I came in November last year and the 1 complaint we had was that the deserts were not great at the time. But now? It was phenomenal. Cheesecake was light and airy, the Lime mousse was great, the chocolate mousse was good as well.

Yesterday was my parents anniversary so I am so glad the food was delicious. I forget the name of the girl who was our waiter but she was very attentive and helpful. | I recently visited Flow at Hilton Colombo Residences for an official lunch with business partners, and it was the perfect choice for a corporate gathering.
​One of the biggest challenges with business groups is catering to different dietary needs, but Flow handled it effortlessly. The buffet was able to cater to both the vegetarian and halal members of our group with plenty of variety for everyone.
​The Sri Lankan section was a standout—the flavors were authentic and truly well-executed. Beyond the mains, the dessert spread was impressive with a great range of choices. To top it all off, the coffee latte was excellent and served as a perfect finish to the meal.
​The atmosphere is professional yet relaxed, making it easy to hold a conversation. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a high-quality, inclusive dining experience in Colombo. | Some staff members are good🥰 Some are okay. Calm environment. Nice looking. Food aren't tasty. I went there on a friday for weekday lunch buffet. Buffet spread is low🥲 Not worth for money. Washroom is beautiful but bad smells are there🥹I didn't expect it from HILTON. They have to improve their quality✨ | We had a truly delightful experience at Flow.The atmosphere was calm and not overly crowded which helped us to enjoy our time comfortably. The buffet offered variety of dishes with the Indian corner, sushi selection, and desserts standing out as more flavorful.

The dumplings and steamed seafood were a bit mild for my personal taste. the overall quality and presentation of the food were great. A special mention goes to the team for arranging a birthday cake upon our request which added a thoughtful touch to our celebration. We are grateful for the warm service and would certainly recommend Flow for a pleasant and enjoyable dining experience. | Had lunch at this buffet, and they offer a wide international selection, including Asian cuisine, a sushi bar, and a good range of desserts. The variety was great, but the taste was just average —not bad, but nothing outstanding either except their baked fish and the mongolian rice which was really good.

The sushi bar was a nice touch, and the dessert selection had plenty of options to try. Overall, it's decent if you're looking for variety, but if you're after exceptional flavors, it might not fully deliver.
Friendly staff too.

name: Panaash - Indian Sweets, Groceries & Faluda's
address: No: 245 Havelock Rd, Colombo 00600, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
ordered a rasmalai through uber but they sent a frozen one. How are we supposed to eat it? If you’re selling an item like this, it should be clearly mentioned. It’s not nice to sell it this way. Even when I called they spoke very rudely. Really disappointed with the place. | This is a little shop that serves mouthwatering little sweet treats down Havelock Road. Panaash specialises in sweetmeats, faludas, samosas ,Punjabi samosas,a variety of crisps and munchies.
Panaash also sells three kinds of Samosas, the Punjabi Samosa, the Chicken Samosa and the Beef Samosa each at Rs.50. The Punjabi Samosa was a favourite, stuffed with squishy potatoes and peas with a hint of fenugreek which I tried since Chicken Samosa wasn’t available.
For drinks I tried their Rose Faluda. Indian sweets are incomplete without a glass of Faluda. If you want to try the best Faluda in town, you need to drop by at Panaash! Faluda is made with Sherbet syrup, semolina and Ice Cream. The presentation was normal and it looked eyeful. It was delicious, decadently presented in a large glass.
For take away I got a Pistachio Kulfi and 2 Barfis and unfortunately I cannot remember the name of the other sweet I got. The Kulfi was well presented in a small pot. They’ve got different other flavors such as Mango, Almond, Faluda and Chocolate. The Kulfi was more denser and creamier than the regular ice cream and was consisted with lots of pistachios which was actually my favorite.
The Barfi was made with condensed milk and sugar with a hint of rose essence. They’ve also used cardamoms to spice up the flavor and included a generous amount of pistachios in it and the flavors were well balanced.
Staff was very friendly and welcoming. Panaash had a lot of free space when I dropped by. All the sides were decked with imported sweets and many more. Unlike many other Bombay sweet sellers. They undertake pre orders on Chicken Biriyani which Rs.390 per 250g and also sells Chaat on every Sunday.
Panaash does offer authentic sweets that are made right at the little shop. If you ever crave for some Bombay Sweets and Chaat, do drop by at Panaash! | I was expecting pani puri to be great but it was okay. Their biriyani was great. Also I liked the samosa. My expectations for pani puri and dahi aloo puri was high but this place couldn't satisfy my tastebuds | Very expensive. The quality is not bad and also not so good when compared to other chaat shops. The faluda is so good but the sugar level is high | Poor quality products. Not worth the money. Using commercial ghee, so no ghee flavor is authentic and  unable to eat the sweets.

name: Royal Thai - Cinnamon Lakeside
address: 117 Colombo - Batticaloa Hwy, Colombo, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
We stopped here for a lunch break at the Thai restaurant inside Cinnamon Lakeside Hotel. When we first asked the hotel reception where the Thai restaurant was located, the staff told us that there was no Thai restaurant in the hotel, which was confusing since Google Maps clearly showed one. At first, we wondered if there was a language misunderstanding, but in the end, we decided to walk around and look for it ourselves — and we did find the Thai restaurant.

Once inside, the restaurant staff were friendly and attentive, which was a positive experience. The food quality was okay. We ordered fried rice per person, thinking the portion would be individual-sized. However, when the food arrived, the portion was very large, easily enough for about three people to share. Unfortunately, this was not explained to us in advance, so we couldn’t finish it and it resulted in food waste, which was disappointing.

The fried rice was decent, though using jasmine rice would make it feel more authentic for a Thai restaurant.

Overall, the service at the restaurant was good and the food was acceptable, but clearer communication and more attention to authenticity would improve the experience. | We went for lunch during the LKR 3500 promotion. It was a three course meal. Every course was delicious and it was absolutely worth the price. The desert was my personal favorite, a mango sticky rice with peanut chocolate.
The interior was beautiful with a cultural touch and a promising view of the city.
The staff were very well managed, friendly and gave us a good description of food.
What I did not enjoy was the loud chatter of the neighboring tables. It was a point which kept us from having a great experience. However I do not see that as an issue of the hotel.
Overall a very good experience.
Highly recommend. | Went there to have dinner with my wife. They haven’t marked my reservation. They gave us a regular table without mentioning anything . But we noticed that we were not given a reserved table (reserved table had a better setting). We mentioned again that we did a reservation, and only then they offered a reserved table. They cross checked my phone number and I overheard that the person answered my call might have forgotten to note down the reservation. They didn’t mention anything to us or apologized for the inconvenience from their side.

The food was good, but not exceptional specially for the price.

The service was by the book bare minimum I would say, and it was not friendly, no smiles. Expected better friendly and helpful service from a high end restaurant like this. | Royal Thai has always been one of my favorite places for Thai cuisine, and once again, it didn’t disappoint. The service was great—attentive and professional.
We had the chicken fried rice, veg pad Thai, stir-fried snapper in red pepper sauce, and garlic & pepper prawns. Every dish was packed with flavor and cooked to perfection. Definitely worth the price.
The cocktails were just okay, but the milkshakes were surprisingly good. Overall, it was a delicious and satisfying meal. Highly recommend if you’re craving authentic Thai food in a classy setting! | The price is not included in the menu because you are charged an additional 25 percent, which is revealed in the payment, for taxes, in
addition to 10 percent for service.
Also very spicy dishes. The pad Thai was good

name: Governor's Restaurant
address: 100 Hotel Rd, Dehiwala-Mount Lavinia, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
​I recently hosted a business lunch at The Governor’s Restaurant, and it was a fantastic experience. Even in the middle of a scorching Colombo day, the restaurant remains incredibly comfortable thanks to the beautiful seaside view and the constant, cool sea breeze that flows through the space.
​The food was the true star, specifically the authentic Sri Lankan cuisine. I highly recommend the Kuruluthuda (heirloom red rice)—it was excellent when paired with their dhal and vegetable curries. It’s a sophisticated way to enjoy traditional local flavors in a setting that feels both historic and refreshing.
​The combination of the colonial architecture, the ocean breeze, and the high-quality food makes this an ideal spot for an impressive business meeting. A must-visit if you want to escape the city heat while enjoying a world-class meal. | An old favourite of mine. The rooms were direct sea view on third floor, and stunning view.

The food was OK, but could have been better.

We had the breakfast buffet in the morning which was great. But room service menu could have been better. That’s not to be negative, but always room to improve.

The staff are fantastic and always very police and helpful.

This is a hotel that I will come back to again and again. Loved my stay here. | I have been here few times. The food is always excellent but, the service is always questionable. We went here for dinner on a Sunday, for the Ape Kama, after making a reservation for a 7 people. The service was less than mediocre, considering the price you pay for the buffet and the number of people that was there, well understaffed.

The meal went unappreciated because of the poor service. The food was excellent, though. | I recently visited Governor's Restaurant at Mount Lavinia with a few close friends, and we were absolutely delighted with our experience. The lunch buffet was simply outstanding—every dish was bursting with flavor and prepared to perfection. From the starters to the desserts, everything was delicious and beautifully presented.

The variety on offer was impressive, catering to a wide range of tastes, and the quality of the food truly stood out. The ambiance of the restaurant added to the overall charm—elegant yet relaxed, making it perfect for a leisurely afternoon meal with friends.

The staff were courteous and attentive without being intrusive, ensuring we were well taken care of throughout our visit. We all left with happy hearts and full stomachs!

Highly recommended if you are looking for a satisfying buffet experience in a beautiful setting. | Governor's restaurant is the main restaurant of Mount Lavinia hotel with wow! kind of seaview restaurant space.

Service eas very fast and no waiting at all. Staff is attentive and friendly. They gave us multiple servings of rice and curry apart for the meat item. Meat potion is more than enough for rice.
Overall it’s a good place to have a homey meal. Not recommended for romantic hangouts or gatherings of any sort, place is purely suited for dining. Don’t be afraid of how it looks from outside coz inside is spacious and tidy.
Wish they had a selection of drinks like tea coffee or lassi. All they had was soft drinks. That was the only negative thing to point out. | A place that totally surprised us starting from the entrance which is a tiny doorway heading into a restaurant space that is decently clean but the best was the amazing food. Totally recommend this place to anyone who likes adventure topped with tantalizing flavors. | Proper Jaffna food, came here in 2018 and the taste is still the same.  Highly recommend to anyone who wants an authentic Tamil Virundhu sappadu. | A hidden gem in Wellawatte! We've been here many times, and they never disappoint when it comes to the taste and quality of their food.

We tried the omelette rice — it was delicious, and the rasam added a nice finishing touch.

The staff were welcoming and helpful. Although the space is limited, the customer service was excellent. Overall, it's a great place to try some authentic Jaffna cuisine. | Great place for a puttu feed with crab curry. Their chicken and mutton curries are also pretty good. The waiters are polite and friendly. Just know that this is a typical saivar kade equivalent of a place selling non-veg meals. Prices are great too. It's not a big place, and probably can accommodate about 25 people. If you are a group larger than 4 best to make a reservation, because they do. There's one large table that could seat 8 that they usually hold for reservations.

name: The Fort Fusion
address: 7 Hospital St, Colombo 00100, Sri Lanka
review_texts: This rooftop restaurant has breathtaking views from the open sitting area which is also the Smoking Zone for the guests. The restaurant serves delicious and quite elaborate breakfast buffet catering to the palate of local, Indian and Western guests. Specially liked their Seeni Sambal. | Very nice place | Beautiful roof top | amazing place nice location in colombo best place to have drinks with your friends.. | Excellent food and Nice Colombo view

name: Sri Suryas Hotel
address: 255 Sea St, Colombo 01100, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
Paneer dosa and chutneys are a dream!! Perfect taste crunchiness, quite irresistible.
Service and cleanliness on point.
Overall fantastic as good as in India or even better! Can’t wait to try more ! | Mushroom  biriyani was so good Chapathi set also fine, masala dosa average . Chatny no salt . We ordered Paneer butter masala but it’s Not butter masala it’s paneer spicy masala. | The food was very good, especially their podi idly, the executive meal. The food was very flavorful and tasty. | We had lunch here at this Tamil restaurant. Unfortunately, the waiter who took our order when we sat at the table was very careless and ignored us while taking the order. Our order took a very long time to be served. We noticed that Tamil customers sitting at the table next to us ordered the same items, even though we arrived and ordered before them, but they were served more than 10 minutes earlier than us.

It felt like Sinhalese customers were given second priority while Tamil customers were served first. We even had to remind the waiter about the delay after noticing that he continued serving people who arrived and ordered after us.

The butter naan was tasty, and we really enjoyed it.

The owner, however, seemed like a very nice person who builds good customer relationships. He personally engaged with customers and took good care of them. Unfortunately, the waiters ruined the experience. The waiters who served us lacked basic service etiquette. We do not expect special treatment, but at the very least, respectful and fair service.

When another waiter brought us the bill after we finished, he slid it onto the table instead of placing it properly, which felt disrespectful and unprofessional.

I also ordered a lassi, and the straw provided was dirty. I had to point this out to the staff and ask for a replacement.

If you are not concerned about service quality, you can visit this place, as the food and drinks are not bad.

I will attach our bill below. | Food was really really good; wish there were more options. We went everyday for 3 days for lunch and dinner. Thaali was really good and so was poori. Really wanted to try the tiffin but this wasn’t available for the time we went. Service was amazing. Really good customer service. Place to wash hands was clean, air con in the restaurant.

name: JoJo's Place
address: RVR7+H4C, 43/6A De Alwis Ave, Dehiwala-Mount Lavinia, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
Excellent customer service with friendly and trustworthy staff. Budget-friendly food with great variety. We've been visiting since 2012 and still love this place. Keep up the great work | Ate here each night of our 3 night stay in Mount Lavinia. Just as good as we remembered from 2016.
Great staff, great food and reasonable priced wine and beer. Devilled cuttlefish was particularly good. One night there was a private party and when it rained at the end of our meal the host invited us in. So even the customers were lovely. | The waiter made me uncomfortable with frequently discussing marijuana. Otherwise, I loved the food. For some reason, they don't list the price for a beer on the menu.

The vegetarian chop suey was good, and the waiter encouraged me to stay for sunset.

I recommend this restaurant overall. | My go-to place to chill and enjoy some beer.
You can BYOB and they also sell and serve beer, wine and everything fine 🫰

Quality of food is great, service is top notch, they also serve sheesha for 2000 and it's just great. An example of what you can get for around Rs. 12,000
3 lion beers
3 carlsberg beers
1 sheesha
1 hot butter mushroom
1 pepper beef
1 fried rice
1 coke
1 strawberry milkshake
1 watermelon juice

Overall worth the money compared to all other locations there on the beach. I have also eaten the following dishes which are just amazing and worth the price
Hot butter cuttlefish
Kotthi rotti
Devilled pork
Fish and chips

A special thanks to the main man there, Uncle Gamini who really serves everyone well.

Went here again today on the 13th of May for an office get together. Still the best. | Quite a nice place. Very quiet on this Tuesday night. They only have beers and ciders. No cocktails. We felt bad to leave so we stayed and had a beer and a lime soda. It took ages to arrive unfortunately. We ate egg fried rice and sweet and sour chicken. I have to say it was delicious. Very large portions too. I wish it wasn’t my last day in Colombo or I would go again. We were entertained by a lovely busker too.
Like many places there’s no toilet paper in the loos. Their beach area is very clean.

name: Garton's Ark Restaurant
address: 9/47 6th Lane, Pagoda Rd, Nugegoda 10250, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
If you're looking for a truly memorable dining experience, look no further than the sailing dinner boat experience. The atmosphere is simply stunning, the service is top-notch, and the food is absolutely delicious - of the highest quality. But what really sets this experience apart is the adventure of sailing while enjoying your meal. It's a unique and unforgettable experience that you won't find anywhere else.

In addition, the staff was extremely helpful and accommodating throughout the entire trip. The Manager went above and beyond to make our experience even more special, arranging a surprise cake. And with the perfect mix of music and the gentle sound of the waves, the entire evening was simply magical.
Special thanks to Captain Rathnakumara for his friendly and welcoming service throughout the entire trip. His warm personality added to the already fantastic atmosphere and made the experience even more enjoyable.

Overall, we highly recommend this experience to anyone looking for a one-of-a-kind dining adventure. | Such a cool way to spend the time and dine at the same time in the Srilanka’s largest sailing restaurant. The staffs are very friendly. And the cruise sailing for around two hours. And the captain let us take photos as a captain in his seat. The buffet here is really nice and very tasty. It have a mini bar also in the cruise. Also they can accommodate many people at one time. It is good for groups and family to dine in and experience the sailing restaurant. Overall everything was good and had such a cool experience. | Let me begin by noting the positive aspects of this location. Cruising and dining together is a truly unique experience. The free cocktail wasn't bad, and some of the food was good. But regrettably, it wasn't a generally enjoyable experience. First of all, the buffet options were extremely limited for the price you pay. I went on April 8 and paid 5000 per head, which was disappointing. Cutleries weren’t clean n it was very unpleasant, And, deserts—god only knows when they were made—it was awful (pretty sure they use the leftovers). The cakes were extremely dry and crumbly, had an odd aftertaste, and offered nothing to savor as a desert. Finally, a buffet without water? Hmm, dubious. Water costs money. If you truly want to eat well, I would not suggest going here. I hope they read these and improve. | This is a total difference experience with a very reasonable price tag. The staff is super awesome. The cruise ship can accommodate around 100 people at once. To have a birthday party I think this place is great. Food is decent. And also liquor and cocktails will be served on board. Plus cigarettes. | This is a great and unique restaurant in Colombo. If you have an idea to give a surprise for your love, I highly recommend this place. There are two decks on the boat. The upper deck (no roof) has seating with a beautiful surrounding view. Food is delicious. Staff is very friendly and helpful. Call to them and reserve before you come.

name: Dinemore - Wellawatte
address: 39 Boswell Pl, Colombo 00600, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
The restaurant has potential, but my recent experience was quite disappointing. As soon as we entered, there was a noticeable unpleasant smell in the area. We waited around 45 minutes for three submarines and one pizza, a guy next to our table ordered after us and he was served max. Within 5-10 mins. , while we had to wait and wait and when the food finally arrived, all the submarines were cold and the portion of fries was very small. We ordered spicy chicken submarines but we received a wrong order it wasnt spicy chicken it was dry and something else, didnt want to create a scene so we ate what was served and paid for it. It seems the owner is focused on opening new branches, but it would be wise to improve the standards and consistency at the existing locations first | We ordered lime juice and Pepsi at the beginning and following that we ordered two and to conclude our dinner we also ordered one chip shake with peanuts.
Chip shake with peanuts is a MUST to try at Dinemore. It was extraordinary...! Chilli chicken shawarma which is the most spiciest in Shawarmas of Dinemore.
It took a bit longer to get our main course but still the wait was worth it.
Calm ambience which is much appreciatable without high volume songs. There are seating spaces outside too where you can enjoy the beach too.
The total bill for us was Rs.3,390 (3 of us) | The restaurant has seating available in two floors but mostly crowded. The waiting time is reasonable and service is okay. Submarines are recommend. | *5/5 Stars*

"I recently dined at Dinemore Resort and had a wonderful experience! Their submarine sandwich is a must-try, it's my favorite dish. This time, I opted for the veg lunch with my hubby, and it was delicious.

One suggestion I would like to make is adding hot beverages to their menu, such as milk tea, plain tea, or hot chocolate. It's a small addition that would elevate the dining experience for customers like me who love pairing hot drinks with their meals.

The ambiance is calm and peaceful, making it an ideal spot for a quiet dinner or a pocket meeting. The staff were friendly, and the food was great. Overall, I highly recommend Dinemore Resort for a relaxing dining experience." | Worst beef chops experience. It was 2400/- and outer part of the beef was deep fried. Chops tasted savor the masala was terrible. Naan was very average. We didn’t finish the food.

name: Abilities
address: 23 Lake Road, Dehiwala-Mount Lavinia, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
Shamini Ovitigama went above and beyond to deliver our needs. My wife and I are so happy with her work, as she catered to our needs spot-on.

Thanks Shamini! |  |  |  |

name: RAW Organic Handcrafted Juices

Also price-wise, it's really good in comparison with western prices! Ronali (the manager/owner) was so so nice to us and even whatsapped us to know how the cleanse was going. She is a super nice lady, 10/10 service and quality. | I have personally tried all cleansing juice available at RAW and its absolutely amazing in every sense. My favorite is the 3 day advance cleansing pack. It was super hard at first for solely relying on juice but its worth it. The body feels light, gain discipline to avoid solid food, clarity in mind and the refreshing feeling is awesome at the end of the 3rd day. Might shed few kgs as well.
I would recommend anyone who wants to try this as its good way to cleanse our bodies with all the food we've been consuming daily. name: Chinese Dragon Cafe - Rajagiriya
address: No. 1082 Kotte Rd, Rajagiriya 00800, Sri Lanka
review_texts:

Don't forget to try the popular and famous hot butter cuttlefish | Chinese Dragon Cafe in Rajagiriya is conveniently located and easy to access. Overall, Chinese Dragon Café Rajagiriya offers both great food and a good atmosphere, making it a place I would definitely recommend and visit again. | RAJAGIRIYA OUTLET..I ordered the Chinese dragon set menu..it took more than 1 hour and 26 minutes... normally there say 45 minutes to 1 hour...if it is late more than one hour what is the rule in sri lanka for this?? Driver came and argued with and he took the food back....early inside in my food had a big warm on the chopsuey..for that I didn't take a action...now I thought show how chinese dragon service

name: Nom Nom Thai Seafood Restaurant
address: 335A McCallum Rd, Colombo 01000, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
Thai food is a flavorful journey that tantalizes the taste buds with its perfect blend of sweet, salty, sour, and spicy flavors. I don't know if it was due to the current situation or not but somehow it was a bit awkward. And the level of service was lacking. Considering the service and the way we felt, the food was pricey. But the scenic view is good. | Food wasn’t that great but ambience & view will absolutely sweep you off your feet.

It’s good place for a small get together.
Ambience- awesome
Restaurant- can’t call it a restaurant

review_texts:

With the all day BOGOF it is the ideal place for a meetup anytime of the day. | Located at Dutch Hospital surrounded by many other restaurants and pubs. Highly recommended

name: Ibrahim Eating House (Beruwala Kade)

One of the best places for tasty Sri Lankan dishes | I ordered from Uber eats guys I need to warn you, it was amazing I got the beef fried rice it tasted so good it tasted like fried rice and biriyani and and it was a little spicy for me but little did I know their gravy tasted like so similar to the elephant house hot dog sauce, it was truly lovely. Enough for 2 people. | I know from 1998. On that, your rice and curry are delicious and valuable for money. But after the renovation management should consider the food quality and customer care. | I once ordered food from here via PickMe. name: Kang’s Kitchen
address: 28/1 Horton Pl, Colombo 00700, Sri Lanka
types: establishment, food, grocery_or_supermarket, point_of_interest, restaurant, store
review_texts:
As someone who has been to Korea many times, I can confidently say that this Korean home-style restaurant is incredibly authentic! We chose it as our last meal in Sri Lanka, and we absolutely didn’t regret it.
The restaurant has a cozy, homey interior, and the four of us ordered quite a lot of dishes (the portions were much bigger than we expected, haha). Even so, we still finished almost everything — which shows just how delicious the food is.
My personal favorite Korean dishes are Gamjatang and Yukgaejang, and the versions here were pretty good as well. It would be even better if the beef in the soup could be the typical shredded beef commonly used in Korea.
The fried chicken, tteokbokki, spicy stir-fried pork, jjajangmyeon, and kimchi pancake were all excellent too. And don’t miss the desserts — they were surprisingly good!
Considering the quality and authenticity, the price is quite reasonable for Colombo. I highly recommend this place! | Kang’s Kitchen Authentic Korean Restaurant was my first visit, and I really enjoyed the experience. The vibe is great, and K-POP fans will absolutely love the place — it’s filled with K-POP posters that add a fun and lively atmosphere. It’s best to make a reservation before visiting. Parking can be a bit tricky since the location and access road are quite small, but there is a valet available who helps manage parking, which makes things easier. The food is great, and you’ll definitely enjoy the authentic Korean flavors here. A nice spot for Korean food lovers. | I've always wanted to try Korean food, and I finally got the chance recently at Kang's Kitchen. The flavors were absolutely mouth watering, and everything we ordered was delicious. I may have gone a bit overboard with ordering and ended up stuffing muself, but it was totally worth it.

The service was really good, friendly, attentive, and quick. The food was beautifully presented and very eye-pleasing, with perfect portion sizes. I especially loved how well the flavors were balanced, with just the right mix of sweet and spice.

The interior is also done really well and adds to the overall experience. Even though I'm not a Kpop fan, I think Kpop lovers would really enjoy the upstairs area, where the walls and ceiling are filled with posters and themed decor. Overall, it was a great first experience with korean food, and I'd definitely go back. | We visited Kang’s Kitchen – Colombo 7 for our very first Korean dining experience in a Sri Lankan restaurant, and it truly exceeded our expectations. We ordered Jajangmyeon, Dak Bokkeum with steamed rice, along with a mango juice and Coca-Cola Zero.
The staff was very supportive, especially when helping us choose dishes since we were new to Korean cuisine. The food was absolutely delicious, rich in flavor and very satisfying. We also loved the restaurant’s cozy and vibrant vibe, which made the experience even better.
Our total bill was around LKR 9,000, which felt reasonable for the quality and authenticity offered.
Overall, a wonderful first taste of Korean food in Sri Lanka 🇱🇰 we’d definitely visit again! | I had the opportunity to enjoy the delicious and authentic Korean cuisine at this restaurant. The food was truly flavorful and absolutely finger-licking good! I was very satisfied with both the taste and the service. Highly recommended for anyone who loves genuine Korean food.

name: Venus Grill
address: 112 Bankshall St, Colombo 01100, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
A famous and well known place in Pettah for its Grill Buns and Cup of tea. This has been the kind of combo for any individual who comes to eat here .

I've tried all the buns at their shop . Except for the curry filling other buns are filled with Nuggets mostly. The best part is that it's grilled at a high temperature in an electric toaster that makes it crispy and fresh .

Their is soo special they add cardamom and ginger . | Great and authentic lunch in Colombo! Staff very friendly and helpful | famous grill bun shop at pettah near the kovil... famous with locals and foreigners.... | A place in pettah we always stop by the food is cheap and very tasty. It's always value for money and the best place for tea. | The wait picked his nose and touch the food with same hand and served to the customer, so soon I leaved this place without ordering anything

name: Zylan Colombo
address: 115 Rosmead Pl, Colombo 00700, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
Stayed here based on a recommendation of friends who live in the area. For a boutique hotel of this level we did not expect our room to look like this.

The hotel is very nice in the lobby and restaurant area. However, the room they assigned us (204) was a different story. The first night there the aircon didn’t work correctly. Then the fan went out in the room. The next day they said it would be fixed but it wasn’t. Instead of moving us to another room they had in this room and took the TV too since the air on was leaking on the table. Finally by day 3 the aircon got fixed along with the fan.

The shower was disgusting as the tile looked like it hadn’t been scrubbed in quite a while with moldy grout. They came in to clean it after we complained. The pictures show after the cleaning.

Went to use the pool on day 2 but it was so cloudy we were afraid to swim in it. So we paid for a hotel where we could not use the pool.

The only positives we had were the service of the staff and the breakfast each morning. The food choices were great and delicious. If a little more care was provided to the rooms themselves the place would have been spectacular. | Nice for a lunch or dinner out. Not very crowded and can easily reserve. Have outdoor and indoor areas. Great for pictures. Food at Zen restaurant is very tasty. Must try the prawn tempura. Tender and succulent. | This tastefully designed boutique hotel in the heart of Colombo is my go-to whenever I visit. The spaces perfectly balance luxury and comfort, the staff are so welcoming and accommodating and every meal is a unique experience from creative fusion dishes to traditional delights. The rooms are spacious and comfortable with so much care and attention to detail adding to the bespoke experience. I couldn’t recommend Zylan enough if you’re looking for a perfectly located escape and unforgettable experience.  Thank you to the Zylan team. | We had a lovely stay at Zylan.  The hotel is real sanctuary from the hectic city outside.

Our room was big and comfortable, and the spa bath was a lot of fun.  The restaurant area is set in a lovely and cool atrium sort of room, with little courtyards leading off it.  Was a beautiful place to have a quiet breakfast.

And the rooftop bar and swimming pool was pretty awesome.

All in all a great experience.  Thanks guys! | From the moment we arrived at Zylan we felt so welcomed and in boutique luxury! The decor and interior design is incredible- there are so many beautiful spots to hang out comfortably. We stayed in room 203 and it was perfect! Spotlessly clean, fresh and the bed was super comfortable too with so much space. ALL the staff were super friendly throughout our stay - special mention to housekeeper Nimal who always stopped for a merry chat!:) highly reccomend if you’re looking for a unique getaway.

name: Chana's - Wellawatte
address: W, 54 W.A. Silva Mawatha, Colombo 00600, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
Last week, I visited Chana’s Restaurant, located in Wellawatta.

Overall, great food, great service, and a warm atmosphere. Definitely coming back again soon!

name: Olive Garden Citi
address: 348 4th Ln, Colombo 11222, Sri Lanka
review_texts:

review_texts:
We decided to dine here recently and had a mixed but ultimately positive experience.

Don’t miss it! | This spot offers a decent, budget-friendly experience centered more on value and service than culinary excellence.

This establishment might not be the top recommendation if your primary draw is a casino that feels like a home away from home for a specific South Asian demographic or if you're looking for the most outgoing and interactive crowd.

review_texts:
We had such a wonderful experience dining here! The food was absolutely delicious from start to finish. The staff were very friendly. | ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The food was incredible — we ordered butter chicken, chicken biryani, mutton rogan josh, garlic naan and cheese naan. Every dish was bursting with flavour, perfectly cooked and served fresh and hot. It really felt like a feast!

A special thank you to our server, Christopher. He was so attentive throughout the night, checking on us just the right amount and making sure we had everything we needed. His service added such a personal touch to the whole experience!!

We’ll definitely be back! 🙌 | Had such a lovely experience at Maharaj Place! The food was genuinely impressive rich flavours, perfectly balanced spices, and everything tasted fresh and authentic. You can really tell care goes into each dish.

But what made the visit extra memorable was the service from Mr. Arthur. Warm, attentive, and super welcoming without ever being overbearing. He made great recommendations and checked in at just the right moments.

Great food + great service = definitely coming back 🙂‍↔️ | I am being quite generous giving this place 3 stars. My expectations were high because of the great reviews, the beautiful location, stunning architecture, and the fact that it serves Indian cuisine, which is my absolute favorite.

We ordered a salad, a soup, grilled chicken, garlic naan, and two curries. When asked whether we wanted starters first or everything together, we explained we had been fasting all day and were extremely hungry, so we asked them to bring everything as soon as it was ready.

The soup arrived first, then the grilled chicken for my partner. I am vegetarian, so I waited. And waited. More than 30 minutes later, a very average salad arrived, still no naan. After 45 minutes, the main dishes finally came. By that point I was starving and honestly already frustrated.

Unfortunately, the disappointment didn’t end there. The Malai Kofta and Palak Paneer were extremely salty, almost inedible. Even though I was very hungry, I couldn’t eat more than a few bites. I was really looking forward to a delicious curry, and this was simply not it.

name: KFC - Nugegoda
address: 128 B/1 High Level Rd, Nugegoda, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
DO NOT EAT FOODS FROM NUGEGODA BRANCH *FOOD POISONING ALERT *

I visited KFC Nugegoda around 9.00 PM and ordered their special offer for dine in. I clearly told the staff at the counter that it was dine in, not takeaway. However, they mistakenly treated it as a takeout order and completely forgot about us.

We waited nearly 20 minutes and no one came to check on our order. Eventually, one of my friends went to the counter to ask what was happening. Only then did they realize our order had been packed for takeaway.

A staff member then told us that our chicken had become cold because of the long delay and said we could not eat it. They replaced the bucket with another one, saying it was hot and fresh. However, when we started eating, it was still clearly not acceptable food.

The rice they served was completely inedible. It was not cooked properly and not mixed well, and no normal person could eat it. I have attached a photo for clear evidence.

We eat KFC regularly across Sri Lanka, and I can confidently say this was the worst KFC experience I have ever had. The chicken had a very strange taste, almost like salt mixed with a tea like or stale flavor, which chicken should never have. It honestly felt like the chicken was old or expired.

To make things worse, we had stomach issues the next day, which raises serious concerns about food safety and hygiene.

Customer service was extremely poor. There was no proper communication and even the AC was turned off, making the environment uncomfortable.

What makes this more disappointing is that KFC Kohuwala is actually very good, with proper service and good quality food. Compared to that branch, KFC Nugegoda is terrible.

This branch seriously damages the KFC brand. A global brand like KFC should never allow standards to fall this low.

My honest advice is do not visit KFC Nugegoda. The customer service is poor, the food quality is bad, the rice is inedible, and there is a possible food poisoning risk.

This was a completely unacceptable and disappointing experience | Today I went to KFC Nugegoda. I ordered two spicy rice and 2 zinger burger. They were very tasty. We received our order quickly, and the outlet was clean as well.” | Visited the outlet for a quick lunch on Sunday. There was a 2000 off offer for 8-pc chicken bucket. We also got a double decker burger, some chips, and a biryani. The burger tasted mediocre and didn't even have salad or tomato. Not too sure if this is usually the case with their burgers. The chicken bucket was too not that great and I'm not sure if their quality is degrading or my threahold for taste has gone up. The wash basin area was clean with a working blowdryer. | I order KFC whenever I can’t decide what to eat because it’s my comfort food. I always get the regular biriyani because it’s my favorite. I don’t like the large — I specifically order the regular because it comes with two pieces of chicken, which is perfect for me.
I order from KFC Nugegoda since it’s the closest outlet to my office, not necessarily by choice. Unfortunately, they consistently send me a half-filled rice box, which honestly isn’t even enough for my 5-year-old brother. It’s really disappointing.
Please have this matter looked into. Loyal customers like me deserve a reasonable portion of the biriyani we’re paying for. I’m genuinely sad about this experience.

review_texts:
I had a wonderful experience enjoying authentic Thai food here. Every dish was full of flavor, fresh, and beautifully prepared truly one of the best Thai meals I’ve had!

The service was outstanding as well. Manager Roshana made sure everything was perfect from start to finish. Very friendly

Highly recommend this place if you love delicious Thai food and great service. Definitely coming back | A group of 8 including 2 kids visited on a Thursday (just after April new year holidays) for lunch. We called to make a reservation and they informed us it wasn't necessary during lunch time.

Plenty of seating options available. The staff was friendly as well. I believe they can improve on food preparation time as it took them more than 20 minutes to serve our food. | My recent visit to Siam House Restaurant in Colombo left me with mixed impressions. While the menu prices seemed a tad high, the inclusion of numerous taxes and fees on the bill added an unexpected layer of complexity. The presentation of the dishes, notably my tom yum soup, was disappointing, featuring unsightly marks outside the bowl, indicating a lack of attention to detail.

The restaurant's interior, despite the air conditioning being on, was uncomfortably warm, and the decor felt outdated. Additionally, overhearing staff expressing frustration about extended working hours created an atmosphere that was less than enjoyable for diners.

Regrettably, the food quality fell short of the anticipated Thai standard. The soups, in particular, lacked the vibrant, natural flavors of authentic Thai ingredients and instead tasted more like a generic paste. Despite mangoes being out of season, the absence of mango-related dishes was surprising, especially when compared to other Thai restaurants that manage to offer such items.

On the beverage front, the non-alcoholic choices were notably limited, and the quality was subpar. This was particularly evident in the basic milkshake, which failed to meet expectations. While the staff exhibited friendliness, there appeared to be a need for additional professionalism and training.

In terms of the dessert offerings, the brownie was disappointingly dry. The presentation of the sticky rice with lychee lacked finesse, and the dish was marred by insufficient coconut milk.

In summary, there are several areas that could be improved to elevate the overall dining experience at Siam House Restaurant in Colombo. | The food was to die for. I recently stayed at the Colombo Court Hotel, and while it offers good value and excellent rooms, the hospitality felt a bit rigid for a tourist.
​First, the bright spots: The room itself was fantastic. It was large, impeccably clean, and featured great-quality sheets with plenty of excellent pillows. The bathroom was stocked with plush towels and quality toiletries. Since I arrived fighting a cold, the great selection of coffee and teas in the room was an absolute lifesaver.
​However, the customer service left a lot to be desired. I arrived at noon after an all-night flight. Even though it's the low season and the hotel felt completely empty, the front desk rigidly enforced the 2:00 PM check-in time. They didn't even offer an early check-in for a fee. Instead, I was told I could wait out in the heat by the pool for two hours.
​There was also a strange billing issue at check-in. The front desk asked me for a $43 payment, even though I had already prepaid in full. I had to firmly show them my paperwork showing the booking platform's virtual credit card payment before they backed off. They didn't bring it up again, but it felt a bit like a shakedown attempt.
​Finally, my booking confirmation explicitly stated checkout was between 11:00 AM and 12:00 PM. Yet, at 11:30 AM, staff knocked on my door telling me checkout was actually at 11:00 AM. Even after showing the front desk my confirmation, they insisted their rule was 11:00 AM.

name: The Gallery Café
address: 2 Alfred House Rd, Colombo 00300, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
Absolutely idyllic and hidden little gem tucked away in a backyard courtyard, complete with a gallery and store. We came here three days in a row because we were so impressed with everything. A fantastic spot for lunch and dinner, with a great playlist featuring acoustic versions of well-known songs.

My absolute favorites were the lychee and pear salad, the coq au vin, and the wonderful selection of cakes.

One small suggestion for improvement would be for the waitstaff to become more familiar with the wine list and receive some training so they can provide more specific recommendations. However, this is only a minor drawback… overall, we thoroughly enjoyed our visits. | When you are looking for a calm get away in Colombo, this is one of the best places to try out. The Gallery themed gives this place a unique vibe.

Food was tasty with good amount of spices and herbs. The variety of selection is good. They had a list of good wine options well. The only missing part is the dish I ordered. I had a pork schnitzel, which was not crispy and I felt like it was microwave heated.

We ordered another, which was a vegetarian Bolognese with black olive and feta cheese. This was tasty and I loved it.

Washrooms are well maintained and the staff is friendly and professional. | Visited the Gallery Cafe when in Colombo with friends! Lovely architecture style and some very yummy food. It's a great place to spend time, chill with friends, relax and enjoy the food. We had a number of dishes but their black pork curry with rice is really good! Great ambience and highly recommended.

They also have some really nice art and don't forget to stroll through the different spaces when you are at the restaurant! | If there’s one restaurant in Sri Lanka that truly deserves praise, it’s The Gallery Café. This is the only place in the entire country where I actually finished my plate — and trust me, that says a lot!

I’ve tried several other restaurants during my trip, but none of them even came close. Most places served food that was bland, greasy, or just disappointing. But here? Every single dish was full of flavor, perfectly cooked, and beautifully presented. You can really taste the quality and attention to detail.

Yes, it’s a bit more expensive than other restaurants, but honestly — it’s worth every rupee. The food, the service, the atmosphere — everything feels a level above the rest. The staff are friendly, professional, and make you feel genuinely welcome.

If you’re looking for real, delicious food in Sri Lanka, stop searching — this is the place. Everywhere else, I left half my food untouched… but at The Gallery Café, I cleaned my plate and almost ordered more.

Absolutely recommended. You’ll walk out happy, full, and already planning your next visit. 🍽️✨ | We visited the place twice and had the same experience: the food is amazing - it's obvious that chef knows how to cook a perfect dish. Variety is also good - there's a large menu to choose from. Ambience is amazing. But everything is spoiled by super slow service. You really have to wait an eternity to get something - it's almost impossible to get someone's attention when you need something.
Also, by Colombo's stardarts this place is very expensive. Meal for 2 would be around 20-25k (w/o alcohol).
So overall I would recommend the place, but be ready for a super slow service and high prices.

name: The Joint Pub and Grill

When we visited, there was a live band playing English classics, which added a lot to the experience. The food was tasty, the beer was good, and prices felt fair compared to similar places. It also wasn’t crowded, so we could actually enjoy the evening. Definitely worth checking out. | From the moment we were seated, Jason provided an absolutely exceptional dining experience. address: 2 Galle Rd, Colombo 00300, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
In on the green has lost a lot of its charm. The key failure is the food. We ordered the chicken burger and the pork lingus with mashed potatoes. However, we were served standard pork sausages and a crumped hamburger which lacked some of the items mentioned in the menu. Each dish was 2900 pre tax. I felt that the Bavarian across the street would offer a far superior meal for the same price. So if you have to, do happy hour at in on the green and cross the street for dinner. Bites and others are also expensive in comparison to other places in the near vicinity. | The In… on the Green Pub at Galle Face Hotel has a peaceful and relaxing ambiance, perfect for unwinding. The happy hours from 5:30 to 7:30 PM every day are a nice touch. However, the food was disappointing. We ordered the grilled pork with potato salad, but it lacked flavor and was quite underwhelming. On the bright side, the setting was great, and the atmosphere was cool and pleasant. Hopefully, the food quality improves to match the lovely location! | I recently had the pleasure of visiting “In on the Green,” and it was an experience worth sharing. The first thing that strikes you upon entering is the wonderful ambience and aesthetically pleasing decor. The place has a warm and inviting atmosphere, making it a perfect spot for hangouts and social gatherings.

The highlight of our visit was undoubtedly the stand-up comedy special. It was a refreshing and entertaining addition to the evening, and it’s great to see a venue offering such events. It adds a unique charm and keeps the patrons engaged and entertained.

The food at “In on the Green” is truly a double-edged sword. On one hand, the taste is extraordinary. Every dish we tried was packed with flavors and beautifully presented. However, the portion sizes left much to be desired, especially considering the price. It would be wonderful if the management could revisit the portion sizes to ensure they provide better value for money.

One area where the establishment could improve is in their billing. While the service charge is understandable, the addition of a heavy tax on the bill is a bit off-putting. It’s not common practice for all restaurants to charge taxes separately, and this feels like an unnecessary burden on the customers. It would be more customer-friendly if these charges were incorporated into the menu prices.

In conclusion, “In on the Green” is a fantastic place with a lot to offer. The ambience, events, and food quality are commendable. If the portion sizes and billing practices are adjusted, it could elevate the experience even further. It’s definitely a place I would recommend for a fun night out, especially if you enjoy good food and live entertainment. | Nice, cosy place.Although we went to see the match, audio was not available. Drinks are reasonably priced. Yet food was nothing but ordinary. The portion is covered by over fried French fries. They have good deals for drinks. | The worst place in Colombo - we were waiting like about 40 minutes to receive finally our food (and it was just a snack!). We were not offered any apologies or discounts. So in the end, the check increased by 1,500 due to the tax (there is no tax in other places), which we were not warned about in advance. There is none in other places. I absolutely do not recommend it!!!

name: Beach Wadiya
address: Marine Dr, Colombo 00600, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
We had a lovely evening at Beach Wadia, right on the sand with that classic Koh Lipe relaxed atmosphere. The setting is fantastic—dining practically on the beach, toes in the sand feel, with the sound of waves and a nice breeze. Perfect for unwinding after a day of island hopping.
The food was pretty good overall. We went for some classic seafood dishes: the stir-fried crab with green onions in that rich, savory sauce looked and tasted spot-on—fresh crab, generous portions, and the flavors were tasty with a good balance of sweet, salty, and garlicky notes. The grilled lobster was nicely cooked, tender and flavorful with herbs and lime, paired well with the simple garlic fried rice on the side. Everything felt fresh, which is what you hope for at a beachfront place in Thailand.
Service was friendly and attentive enough, though it can get busy. The little details like the crab cracker tool and the chili dip added a fun touch.
That said, it’s noticeably pricey for Koh Lipe standards—especially compared to some spots on Walking Street or other beaches. The portions and quality are decent, but you definitely pay a premium for the prime beach location. If you’re after value, you might find similar (or even fresher) seafood elsewhere for less, but if you want the convenience and the view, it’s worth it for a special meal.
Overall, a solid choice for a beach dinner with tasty seafood in a beautiful setting. We’d go back for the ambiance, but we’d probably share more dishes next time to keep the bill in check. Recommended if you’re prioritizing location over budget! | If you want delicious, no-frills wholesome seafood fresh from the coast / boat catch, then Beach Wadiya is the place to be.

We were treated to a  delicious seafood dinner of dishes cooked simply, keeping the original flavour of the dishes intact (instead of piling it with a lot of sauces and oils!). We had the Prawn Soup, 2 portions of Oysters with lime and a dash of hot sauce (yum!), 1kg grilled whole fish (from the day’s fresh catch), and a salad as an accompaniment.👏👏

Service and cleanliness was very good. Washrooms are quite alright.

However they need to work on ambient lighting, do something about the cats who try to climb on chairs (!!), and maybe add some light music to enhance the mood. 🙂

Would be good to add some hand sanitizer to the hand washing area in addition to soap as well.

My husband and I loved the food so much that we went back with family within a week! | I had seafood soup and fish fillet with mashed potato. Both dishes tasty, but extremely small portions. I got oysters and I didn't like them. Too bittersih. It's laid back atmosphere. But they could clean their part from garbage. Looks filthy. The waiter should gain more language skills. It is pricey the quality of the service. Do not recommend. | Such a disappointment. We went over for dinner. The wait was so long! Over an hour. The food was absolutely awful! So salty! You can’t eat anything! Every single dish was salty. Even after complaining that the food was not good, there was no manager to be seen. When asked the waiter for the manager he said he’s only there during afternoons. Then asked the cashier who claimed to be the manager.
They re-served the fried rice, a prawn dish and kangkung which was comparatively less salty yet not up to restaurant standards and was still so bad.
When the second set of prawns came in, they weren’t cleaned. Disgusting!

Wouldn’t recommend to anyone who has tastebuds. | ​The quintessential Colombo seafood experience!
​Beach Wadiya is a legendary spot for a reason. Don’t expect fancy decor this is a rustic, toes in the sand shack where the food does all the talking.
​The Food: The Baked Crab is a world-class must try, and the Hot Butter Cuttlefish is perfectly crispy. Everything is fresh, usually based on the catch of the day.
​The Vibe: Sitting between the railway tracks and the ocean provides an authentic, old-school Sri Lankan atmosphere. It's unpretentious and full of soul.
​Service: Friendly, seasoned staff who make you feel like a regular even on your first visit.
​Perfect for a sunset dinner and a cold beer. If you want "real" Colombo rather than a polished mall restaurant, come here.
​Tip: Ask for the "Roast Paan" to soak up the garlic butter sauces!

review_texts:
Pizza Hut Borella has always been a go-to spot for us during our Faculty days, simply because it was the closest and honestly, one of the most reliable! We visited frequently, and the service was consistently excellent every single time. The staff were friendly, efficient, and made sure our orders came out just the way we liked.
The food quality is exactly what you’d expect from Pizza Hut - tasty, satisfying, and always dependable. My favourites have always been the Meat Lovers and the Double Chicken & Cheese pizzas, these are absolute must-tries if you haven’t already!
A great place for casual hangouts, quick meals, or group meetups. Still one of my top picks for pizza in Borella! | Order Directly from Pizza Hut—A Lesson in Quality and Care

I recently had a disappointing experience that turned into a shining example of customer service, all thanks to one employee.

I ordered two pizzas from Pizza Hut Borella through Uber. When they arrived, they were completely ruined crushed and inedible due to the delivery handling. Uber’s support was unhelpful in resolving my complaint.

Frustrated, I called the Pizza Hut Borella store and spoke with an employee named Chamal. He was exceptionally calm and professional. He listened, explained that the damage was caused during delivery by the rider, and sincerely advised that to ensure quality, it’s better to order directly through Pizza Hut in the future. I appreciated his honesty and hung up, satisfied with the explanation.

To my surprise, Chamal called back shortly after. He told me that Pizza Hut would be sending me two replacement pizzas, free of charge. I was truly shocked by this gesture. It wasn’t just about the pizzas, it was a clear demonstration of how much Pizza Hut values and respects its customers.

While my experience with the third-party delivery was terrible, the integrity and outstanding care shown by Chamal and the Pizza Hut team completely restored my faith. I’ll definitely be ordering directly from them from now on.

Final advice: Skip the app—call Pizza Hut directly. They stand by their quality and truly care about their customers.

Overall, this was a frustrating experience considering the restaurant’s reputation and pricing. Significant improvements are needed in food quality, hygiene, and customer service. | I placed an order on Uber Eats for one portion of Tom Yum seafood and one portion of fried rice with Chilli and Hot Basil and I must say I was super disappointed by the portion size! My oh my that ways such a rip off for the price paid my bill came to 3900/- odd inclusive of a huge service fee and tax added to it mind you, but was super super dissatisfied with the portion size.. I paid a whopping 1800 odd for the fried rice and expected something rich in flavor and taste but sadly it was bland, super small in portion and just 4 small pieces of chicken -terrible- | I had a wonderful dining experience at Nara Thai Restaurant. They greeted us warmly and ensured we were comfortably seated without any delay.

The team demonstrated excellent product knowledge and patiently explained the menu, helping us choose the best dishes according to our preferences. Orders were taken efficiently, and the food was served on time with great attention to presentation and cleanliness.

What impressed me most was the staff’s attentiveness and dedication to customer satisfaction. They regularly checked on our table to make sure everything was perfect, while maintaining a friendly and respectful attitude. The service felt organized, smooth, and well-managed, creating a relaxing and enjoyable atmosphere.

The restaurant maintains high standards of hospitality, cleanliness, and professionalism. It is clear that the management and team work together to provide a memorable dining experience for every guest.

I highly recommend Nara Thai to anyone looking for authentic Thai cuisine combined with exceptional customer service. I will definitely visit again and recommend it to friends and family.

I hope management takes strict action so this does not happen to other customers. | Yesterday, I visited Pizza Hut Bambalapitiya for a dine-in experience. I had a valid coupon offering Rs. 1,000 off on a large pizza. Before placing the order, I showed the coupon to the cashier and asked whether it was valid. This experience was very poor and far below the standard expected from Pizza Hut. I am truly disappointed with the service at this outlet and hope this feedback will be taken seriously to improve customer service in the future. | I am giving 1 star, only for the location, but the service and staff attitude were completely unacceptable. name: KFC - Colombo 1
address: 23 Canal Row, Colombo 00100, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
A shameful experience. I was informed that an 8-piece order would take 15 minutes, which is fair. However, this particular visit was anything but busy. The outlet was calm, with very few pending orders. Staff appeared relaxed, the person taking my order was casually chatting with customers, and even a manager-looking staff member in a black shirt seemed unhurried.

Given this, I checked in after 10 minutes, as is usually the case at most KFC branches where orders are already being wrapped up by then. Unfortunately, that wasn’t the case here. There was no sense of urgency or proactive service.

I finally received my order after 25 minutes, well beyond the promised time - despite the outlet clearly not being under pressure.

What makes this particularly disappointing is that this branch is one I used to visit frequently in 2021–2022 when working at WTC.

Back then, under Mr. Darshan, the manager at the time, service standards were exemplary. Orders were handled efficiently, delays were rare, and customer experience was clearly a priority. The contrast between then and now is stark.

The sad fact is that the guy in the black shirt looked at my face with no expression as I expressed my dismay with the delay, only one employee from a distance apologised.

This decline in service quality is not just disappointing - it’s a shame, especially considering the strong reputation KFC Sri Lanka has built across its outlets.

I hope this feedback is taken seriously - and action be taken against the man in the black shirt who has NO REGARD for customer service and was casually chatting away with some customers - particularly one family, because this level of complacency does a disservice to the brand and to loyal customers who expect better. | This is by far the worst KFC I’ve ever visited in Sri Lanka. I’ve been to over 10 KFC outlets across the country, and this one was the most disappointing. The air conditioning wasn’t working, making the environment very uncomfortable. The washroom was in terrible condition – unclean, poorly maintained, and shockingly, there was no mirror. For a well-known international brand like KFC, this level of service and cleanliness is unacceptable. It completely ruined the dining experience. I expected much better standards. I will definitely not be returning to this location and wouldn’t recommend it to others either. Very disappointing. | Visited this KFC outlet for a quick lunch. Overall the meal was unsatisfactory. The management should rethink about the portion size again since I cant imagine the size of a regular biriyani after witnessing a large one. | Yuck, Yuck , Yuck! and I really should start with a different letter..I have visited more than 6 times. As a foreigner the KFC brand is very well known in our country and across the world. Hence I am dissapointed to report back that both the quality and service is shockingly bad. Firstly you cant order nuggets or strips by themself, you cant order a pepsi 2L or any other variant ( only cups) as per the cashier which must be bought as a combo- a bit ridiculous since the supermarket across the road sells 500ml bottles for 200 rupees. Breyani is a  really good concept but it was a total dissapointment due to  such a tiny piece of chicken with ordinary rice. Every piece of chicken in Colombo KFC including burgers is spicy and not suitable for kids less than 5 years old which is not the norm in western countries.Chips were burnt and hard on many occasions. Location is good near the trade centre but watch out for the massive rats outside at night! However what has pissed me off the most is the lazy dont care attitude of the cashier, no greeting and rude response if you ask for extra  straws/ serviettes as though he is doing me a favour.If it was not for my kids wanting something familiar I would have never went here since the other American brands are better. What drove me to write this review was my final  visit which was hard , stale and extra salted ( not edible ) fries which is a disgrace to feed to my small children. The complaint I left on my KFC till slip review was also never responded to. So if you a foreigner go if you are desperate else you better of buying back home  or real sri lankan food since the franchisee or the brand doesnt care about feedback or customer service. If the owner wants to improve he should go to another country and experience the KFC difference. The only positive thing I can say is its a bit better than KFC in india although india has better Veg options but by western standards this is a joke of a franchise. review_texts:
☙ Harbour Court is the all day dining restaurant at The Kingsbury Hotel, Colombo, offering a large international buffet with great variety. We visited for the lunch buffet.

☙ Buffet highlights:
•🍨 Desserts are a major standout. beautifully presented and very delicious. The ice cream section includes 8 flavors, plus live ice cream kottu, 🩶 which is truly next level.

•🥙 The salad and cheese sections are outstanding. Huge variety, extremely fresh, and easily one of the best salad spreads I’ve experienced.

•🍖 Meat dishes were excellent. Beef and pork are highly recommended. In the Western section, you can even request a full chicken piece, and it was fantastic.

☙ Live stations are a major highlight:
•🍕 Live pizza & pasta (custom ingredients)
•🍝 Stir-fry noodles & soup noodles
•🍣 Sushi bar
•🥘 Indian tandoori grills
•🥗 Fresh salad counters
•🥩 Meat carving stations (varies by meal)
•🍨 Live Dessert Bar

☙ Service:
The chefs at the live stations are exceptional 🩶 easily some of the best I’ve seen in Colombo hotels. Other staff were friendly and polite, though service was fairly standard.

⚠ Small notes ⚠
• The lunch buffet gets very crowded and can feel slightly understaffed, so while service is good, it may not be excellent. A reservation is highly recommended.
• Some tables near the windows receive direct sunlight around lunchtime. We had to change our table, so it’s best to request a table away from windows during peak sun hours.
• Seafood variety was limited on the day.

♨ Overall, Harbour Court offers a high quality buffet with great variety, excellent live stations, standout desserts 🩶, and good value for money.
♨ Highly recommended if you enjoy variety and live cooking.

name: Rocco's
address: 615A Nawala Rd, Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte 10100, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
Overall it was a good experience.

The food was very nice and the beverages were too.

They have seating in the ground floor as well as on the first floor. Lovely ambiance. The staff were friendly.

Can park a few cars in their spaces and there is curbside parking available as well. We went on a weekday and it was very calm and there were only two other parties on that day.

They have soft ambient music as well. Would have been nice if the playlist were longer and though 😌 We were there till the play list repeated two times I guess.

Clean washrooms are available.

Recommended | The pizza I had was excellent. A well-fermented dough with a light, airy crust, nicely blistered from the oven, topped with quality ingredients that tasted fresh and well balanced. Unfortunately, the real disappointment came with the chilli oil. According to the waitress, it has been diluted to better suit the taste palette of foreigners. To me, the chilli oil was the main selling point and what made this place stand out. By watering it down, they’ve effectively turned themselves into just another generic Italian restaurant that happens to serve good pizza.

What frustrates me most is seeing a local establishment choose to cater to foreign tastes at the expense of locals. When I was in Rome, I ate food the way they ate it. It didn’t always suit my palette, but not once did I expect or see restaurants changing their food to accommodate foreigners. That’s the whole point of experiencing authentic cuisine, and it’s disappointing to see that principle ignored here.

Desserts were good. I ordered the lemon meringue pie, tiramisu, and strawberry cheesecake, all of which were enjoyable. These were the only three available, as the rest had been “reserved.” This was close to closing time, so I can only assume someone was planning on having double chocolate cheesecake for breakfast the following day. | ​I had a fantastic experience at Rocco’s Pizza in Nawala! review_texts:

name: t-lounge by Dilmah – Chatham Street ️
address: Chatham St, Colombo 00100, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
I had the chance to visit T Lounge in Colombo and it was a truly unique experience. The variety of teas they offer is astonishing and each one feels carefully crafted. The tea experience itself was superb and the ambiance of the place makes it even more enjoyable.

The service was a little slow start but picked up later .  The food was also very good and paired well with the tea. The place itself is an experience and I’m glad I found this place . Plenty of variety to try their tea and I’d surely come back

I would definitely recommend it to anyone visiting Colombo. | One of my best loved cafes in Colombo. The interior and the details are spot on. Cozy little gem of a place serving a variety of drinks and food. A lot of foreigners milling in and out of this cafe. They serve a welcome drink in a tiny mug, which is very thoughtful.
I was mind-blown by the mungo strawberry drink today. They’ve used flavored black tea with mango pulp & chucks of strawberry to curate the drink, it was truly refreshing with very very minimal sugar.
The spicy chicken crepe was great too, the flavors were on point albeit would have loved more stuffing in the crepe.
Staffs are quite friendly and welcoming feedbacks. Very cozy little outlet. Definitely my go to spot every-time I need some me time.

address: Chatham St, Colombo, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
I visited here a few times as recommend by by hotel around the corner. First impressions are a bit low but it's a locals restaurant with local food at local prices.
My first visit was late evening around 9 pm. Service was a little slow but it's because after a few visits it's a self serve, not table service so it was good someone served me at the table at all. I ordered a Dolphin chicken Kottu and was very disappointed as the chicken contained lots of bones. Kottu should have no bones at all so I'm not sure what happened. Other than the bones, the Kottu was actually nice.
I returned for breakfast and had a selection of pastries and 2 cups of milk tea. The milk tea is wonderful. It's so tasty and I highly recommend going here for the milk tea alone. My for pastries ( viyana roll, wade, ada and pol cake) and 2 milk teas cost just 550 lkr (£1.35) which is such a good price. The pastries were filling and I took two away with me.
I returned for dinner, was familiar with how to order now and went straight to the counter and ordered a vegetable Kottu and was asked how spicy I'd like it. It was delicious and such a large portion I could not finish it. It cost me 400lkr (98p).
I returned again for breakfast, by now the staff knew me, waved and said hello. I ordered at the counter again and had pastries and milk tea. I had a short conversation with a local office worker who sat at my table and had some kind of curry for breakfast and I had a chat with the man who makes the milk tea.
This is a great place to eat and to get a real feel of proper Sri Lanka cafe life. Just sitting, drinking milk tea and watching and talking to the locals is great.
I was concerned initially about hygiene as I have a very sensitive stomach when it comes to eating but in my 4 visits here I did not have any problems at all.
Please visit here and experience real Sri Lanka for yourself. | Quite good restaurant, taste is acceptable, price is cheap, we order, chicken KUttU and Chicken fried rice, both dishes quite good , self service, cleanliness must be improved | Extremely helpful and friendly staff.

A truly unforgettable dining experience, I can’t recommend it highly enough | We made reservations before arriving in Colombo as our expectations were high and this restaurant absolutely delivered.
