My parents and I are very familiar with seafood. We cook it regularly at home and eat it often in restaurants, so we know good quality when we taste it. I can honestly say this is one of the best seafood restaurants we’ve been to.

It was so good that we ordered two additional dishes, both different and equally delicious. To finish, we had one of their chocolate desserts, which was the perfect sweet ending to a fantastic meal.

Highly recommended. | This was always on my bucket list and this place sure didn't disappoint!

Went with a friend who is an equal food and sea food lover. We ordered for the prawns and a kilo crab in srilankan curry.

The prawns were big palm sized so felt a bit chewy. We ordered two prawns one in Garlic chilli and Butter soy. The garlic chilli was definitely better and a big flavour bomb. We enjoyed this with Kade bread a perfect accompaniment.

Next up crab in sri Lanka curry. Just perfect. The meat well cooked and flavours completely soaked by the crab. It was our first time eating a full shelled crab and the process of deshelling and eating was exhausting but it felt like a win when we got it right and of course the prize was the delicious crab meat.
We ordered the Garlic Rice which was so so so good but unfortunately we couldn't eat much of it because we were thoroughly stuffed and surely overate.

Our bill was $243 which might sound pricey for two but compared to Indian restaurant pricing it was at par.

Definitely a must visit. | Absolutely delicious 🤤 The crab was cooked to perfection — tender, juicy, and full of flavor. Finger-licking good! The clams were also incredible, served in the most amazing sauce ever.

The team and the manager were incredibly attentive, caring, and professional, making the entire evening even more special.

This is definitely the number one place to visit in Colombo. Highly recommend from the bottom of my heart! 🦀✨ | Came here to experience the Sri Lankan crabs. Best to make a reservation as this place is popular. The chawanmushi is highly recommended. We had the pepper crab and the MOS chilli crab. Have to be careful about ordering the size of the crabs as prices are very high. The bread we ordered was a bit disappointing. The crabs were fresh and good flavour with the sauces. However, due to the high prices, this is a place that can be frequented only on occasion. Service was friendly and prompt. The menu is all in US$.

name: Dinemore - Thurstan Rd
address: 20 Thurstan Rd, Colombo 3, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
We went there to have dinner and the experience was not pleasant.
Once we arrived, we had to sit on a quite dirty place as there wasn't much space as the place was quite busy. There were food spilled on chairs.
Once we made the order, the waiter brought us our drinks rather quickly. Then again, he came and gave the plates and cutlery to my partner. He wasn't even bothered to arrange the table. Do they even know that it's a part of a waiter's job? I highly doubt it. He just left everything in one place and left. I guess the waiter's job has to be done by the customers.
The first order was out and it took like 20 minutes to bring the next order.
The food was ok. The lasagne wasn't that appetising.
The atmosphere wasn't ideal the workers themselves were gathering and shouting. It's better if the waiters are taught the table etiquette, which is part of their job,. And treat the customers right.
I don't recommend this place if you want to have a decent dinning experience. | Had a great experience at the Dinemore Thurstan Road outlet. I ordered the Tuna Submarine and it was really fresh, well-prepared, and full of flavor. The service was quick and efficient, with the waiting time being less than 10 minutes. Staff were organized and the outlet was clean. Definitely a reliable spot for a quick and tasty meal. 👍 | The portions were just right and everything tasted really good. Overall, a great spot for a satisfying meal! | Dinemore! Thurstan is a different place with a different vibe. The location is convenient, and parking is available. Generally, they prepare meals quickly without any impact on the taste. The staff is friendly. I went this place several times and no bad experience up to now. I recommend this place | This is the beat outlet out of all other Dinemores. Foods are always tasty. Staff is really friendly. Atmosphere is great. Have a big space inside. name: Simply Strawberries by Jagro
address: 2 Srimath Anagarika Dharmapala Mawatha, Colombo 00300, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
I’ve tried several strawberry dishes at Simple Strawberry by Jagro, and most of them are really tasty and fresh! 🍓 The cheesecake is delicious - creamy and full of strawberry flavour. 😋

But honestly, the strawberry tart was a miss for me - no real taste, so I wouldn’t recommend it. Also, we ordered extra strawberries because the staff didn’t mention that most dishes already come with plenty.

A small tip - the shop is a bit hard to find as it’s behind a building, but it’s located right in front of the Cotton Collection store. Once you find it, you’ll love the cozy vibe and sweet treats! 🍓✨ | Visited Simply Strawberries by Jagro—seriously loved the atmosphere! Strawberry-based items are super yummy. A must-try place for strawberry lovers. | A great place to have desserts...

Simply strawberries is one of my go-to places for desserts. Especially when it feels like having some strawberries. I have been there with my family and colleagues too. Recently I went there with some colleagues to have an afternoon snack/dessert. The atmosphere was quiet as usual and very calm.

We quickly went through the menu and made our selections. They have a grate range of desserts containing fresh strawberries, natural strawberry topping, raspberry toppings along with ice cream, waffle, cakes, cheesecakes and many more. In the beverage department you have coffee, fresh strawberry juice and milkshakes. Now they offer New York style cheesecake, lemon cheesecake and double chocolate cheesecake where you can have them with or without your choice of toppings apart from the usual strawberry and raspberry cheesecakes. We ordered Meringue sundae, strawberry topping & Ice cream, strawberry tart, classic new York style cheesecake, double chocolate cheesecake. All were pretty good. We liked them. And they were filling too.  Be warned that some of the options have big portion sizes almost like a meal. Especially sundaes, waffles.

We received a nice and efficient service from the staff. We didn't have to wait longer to get the order.

Overall we had a nice time with some yummy desserts. As always we loved it. | ☆Food☆
Strawberry cheese cake was heavenly. It was one of the best cheese cakes I ever had. Jagro mess & Meringue sundae were good but bit overpriced.
Strawberry Milkshake fell short of my expectations.

☆Service☆
Service is quite good and fast, waiting time was roughly about five minutes.
It was quite impressive considering that just two people are working there.
Cleanliness & Food handling are good.

☆Atmosphere☆
There are just four tables outside, that can accommodate upto 15 people at a time. Nothing noteworthy. | Visited Simply Strawberries recently and had a lovely experience! We tried the strawberry cheesecake, it was delicious, with fresh strawberries that added the perfect touch of sweetness.

The ambiance was calm and pleasant, making it a great spot to relax and enjoy a dessert.

Definitely worth a visit if you’re a fan of strawberry treats! 🍰✨

name: Grand Rovinka Hotel
address: 103 Sri Somerathana Mawatha, Boralesgamuwa 10290, Sri Lanka
types: bar, establishment, food, lodging, night_club, parking, point_of_interest, restaurant
review_texts:
Grand Rovinka Hotel is a gem tucked away in a quiet setting. Their rates are more than reasonably priced, with excellent facilities including the best restaurant in Colombo and a great bar. The rooms are spacious with beautiful traditional style furniture and well appointed. But, the best of all are the staff. They will go the extra distance to help and that is all of the time. This is an excellent and friendly hotel I would recommend on your next stay in Colombo. | There is a nice bar. The vibe is awesome. Rice is good for a drink. The vibe is awesome AC Reasonable menu on food. 10% SC

PARKING AVAILABLE

ROOMS AVAILABLE - But privacy must increase | no one should look at guest in suspicious way waiting at car park and front area | felt very comfortable in this hotel.bar is very nice place.the vibe is awsome .we arranged some birthday party.they have tasty foods.also kindly and helpful staff.special thanks to assistant manager ms.madhusha.i recommend this place  to all people . | My recent business trip to Colombo was marred by a deeply disappointing stay at Grand Rovinka. Despite reading some negative reviews, I decided to give it a chance, a decision I now deeply regret. I booked a superior deluxe king room, their best available option, which, to be fair, appeared to be new and well-maintained. However, the modern appearance was completely overshadowed by a series of unacceptable issues that rendered the room and the entire experience useless.
During the daytime, the air conditioning was seemingly on but produced no cool air. When I called reception, a staff member came to my room and simply told me to use the ceiling fan, despite the fact that I had paid for a room option that included all amenities. The situation only worsened when I tried to take a shower to escape the unbearable heat. Both the shower and the bathtub had scalding water gushing from them, so hot that steam was billowing out after just five minutes, turning the bathroom into a sauna. What was even more frustrating was the evident lack of knowledge from the staff; they seemed to have no idea how to properly operate the fixtures. I contacted reception again, but it took them 30 minutes to send someone who was unable to fix the issue, telling me it would be fine in a while. The issue was not fixed for the entire 22 hours I was there.
What made this ordeal even more frustrating was the complete lack of empathy from the staff; they didn't even have the decency to apologize for the inconvenience. This experience was a nightmare. To have both the AC and a working shower fail, and to be met with such unhelpful and untrained staff, completely ruined my stay. While the rooms looked new, this is pointless when the entire experience is ruined by a lack of basic functionality and competent service. This was, without a doubt, one of the worst hotel experiences I have ever had. | We had an absolutely wonderful stay at Grand Rovinka Hotel ! The staff made us feel welcome and truly went out of their way to ensure a fantastic experience. The level of service was exceptional ,  everyone was friendly, professional, and always ready to assist with any request, no matter how small. The hotel itself is beautiful, with cozy, well appointed rooms that felt like a home away from home. The attention to detail in both the decor and the amenities was impressive. What really stood out, though, was the incredible customer service. Every member of the team took the time to engage and make sure all of my needs were met. It's clear they genuinely care about their guests.

The overall experience at Rovinka was top notch, and  I'll definitely be back !

name: Diner’s Lounge Restaurant
address: 18a Palmyrah Ave, Colombo 00300, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
I’ve ordered from Diner’s Lounge three times via Uber Eats, including twice using their BOGO offers. I tried the Chicken Hong Kong Rice, Prawn and Chicken Thai Noodles, and a Large Diner’s Lounge Special Mixed Rice.
The portions are very generous. Even the standard portion is filling, and the large portion is easily enough for two people. The food arrived neatly packaged and well presented.
Most importantly, the taste was really good. Flavourful, satisfying, and generous with both meat and seafood. Overall, great value for money and consistently tasty. Would definitely order again. | I visited Diners Lounge Colombo for the Iftar combo after seeing many influencer posts on social media. Unfortunately, the real experience was very different from what was shown online.

The portion sizes were quite small and the overall food quality did not meet expectations for the price. The presentation and variety also didn’t match what was advertised in the videos.

I hope the management improves the quality and consistency because the place has potential. But based on my experience, the Iftar combo was disappointing. | Recently I visited Diner’s Lounge Restaurant and tried their Iftar platter. It was very filling and definitely worth the price. The food was tasty and well prepared, making it a great option for Iftar with friends or family. Overall, it was a satisfying experience and I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a good Iftar meal. 🌙🍽️ | Went here for an office lunch outing, and honestly, it was a disappointing experience. While the place is calm and the dining area reasonably clean, the upstairs section was hot—clearly, the air conditioning wasn't doing enough cooling.

We ordered around 30 dishes with various options, and while the food arrived quickly, the quality was underwhelming. The chicken fried rice, seafood fried rice, and chopsuey fried rice were all bland, lacking both color and flavor. None of them were spicy or appetizing, and the provided chili paste was insufficient—we had to ask for more multiple times. Adding some kind of gravy would’ve helped, but nothing was offered.

And also, I bit into egg shell pieces more than once in the chicken fried rice, which was just disgusting. The only positive was the portion sizes, but that's not enough to make up for everything else.

Based on this experience, I wouldn't recommend this place. | I definitely did read reviews of this place before I went in, and all of them said one thing. It's worth the money you spend here and the portion size is good.

And that's just what it was, the food was good and fresh. And the portion size was good too.

They definitely needed to get some new menus and they were falling apart.

If you are looking for an affordable place to hangout or to bring your partner for a casual meal this definitely is the place.

Great variety of food and definitely not too heavy on your wallet. I wish there was some music playing in the background, that's something that would add more to the dining experience.

Check it out!

There's a nice rustic look to the place, and a little bit of music on the speakers too | Used to be a big fan of Gami Gedara in Kotte, especially their pork and chicken curry a few years back it was chef’s kiss. But recently, it feels like they’ve lost a bit of that magic. The food’s still okay and definitely edible, but the flavor just doesn’t pop like it used to. name: Loon Tao
address: 43, 12 College Avenue, Dehiwala-Mount Lavinia, Sri Lanka
review_texts:
Visited Loon Tao in Mt. Lavinia to celebrate my father’s birthday with family. It was a weekday, so the place wasn’t too crowded, but the food took over 30 minutes to arrive at our table, which was a bit disappointing. However, the wait was worth it, the food was tasty and the portions were very generous. A large dish was easily enough for three people. The staff were well dressed and polite, but we had to remind them to serve the food onto our plates. The beachfront setting is peaceful and relaxing. A nice bonus is that you can bring your own liquor bottle without any corkage fee. Overall, a great place for a calm dinner by the sea with good food and reasonable prices. | I visited this restaurant on 01.01.2026 and ordered Yangzhou Style Seafood Rice. Before ordering, we specifically asked the waiter whether the rice contained seafood, and she confirmed that it did.

However, when the food arrived, there was almost no seafood at all. When we informed the manager, he used his phone torch to point out a few very tiny pieces and said that this is how the dish normally comes.

If that is the case, the waiter should have clearly informed us before ordering. That is basic customer service.

Additionally, the waiter who served us had a very unpleasant attitude and seemed angry when we questioned the dish, which made the experience worse — especially disappointing as this happened on New Year’s Day.

At the time of paying the bill, another staff member came and politely accepted that a mistake had happened, which I appreciate.

Food quality and transparency need improvement, and staff should be trained to communicate properly with customers. Photos are attached to support this review. | I recently visited Loon Tao, and it was a wonderful experience. The food was absolutely delicious—every dish was full of flavor, fresh, and perfectly cooked. If you love authentic and tasty Chinese cuisine, this place will not disappoint.

The staff were moderately kind and welcoming, making sure we were comfortable throughout our visit. The service was smooth and pleasant.

One of the best parts about this restaurant is its beautiful location right in front of the beach. You can enjoy your meal while listening to the waves, and if you prefer, you can even arrange a table directly on the beach. It’s a perfect spot to relax, have a drink, and enjoy a lovely evening with friends or family.

Overall, it’s a great place for tasty food, a nice atmosphere, and a peaceful beachside experience. I would definitely recommend it! | Outstanding experience at Loon Tao!

Had a truly enjoyable time at Loon Tao. The food was delicious — full of flavourand fresh. Every dish felt thoughtfully prepared and absolutely worth it.

If you’re looking for great food paired with exceptional service, Loon Tao is definitely a place you won’t regret visiting. | they served me spoiled crab. when u get the mud crab without meat inside that because the crab not longer fresh and when u cook it all the meat is turn into liquid.
